scene_spec.title: G1 safe route to Gusev summit
assumptions: Terrain: real elevation data, Gusev / Columbia Hills area (Spirit), Mars (U01 uncontrolled) (80 m square, 24.1 m of relief, typical slope 18.1°). Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona HiRISE DTM.
Moved the start 4.3 m to flatter ground: 7.5° instead of 14.9° across the robot's footprint.
Gave the robot up to 120 s to reach the goal: 33.8 m at about 0.55 m/s, times 2.5, kept within 20–120 s.
